title: Hear the Bani until it lifts you
summary: Repeated hearing lifts the soul beyond what one reading can do. Let repeated Bani lift you higher than novelty can.
takeaway: Let repeated Bani lift you higher than novelty can.
lifeApplication: Before chasing a new spiritual input, hear the same Bani again and let repetition do its elevating work.
